checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One playable music audio file is delivered.
must.why: A 15 s WAV with sound and peak -1 dB was delivered.

must.item: The audio lasts 10 seconds, within 0.1 second.
must.why: The file is 15 s. The assistant told the user to trim it themselves.

must.item: The music has a recognizable laid-back hip-hop beat and mellow lo-fi texture.
must.why: I cannot hear the audio. Only the assistant's description is available.

must.item: The overall mood is warm and relaxed rather than tense or high-energy.
must.why: Mood cannot be judged from the numbers.

must.item: No singing or spoken words are audible.
must.why: The audio was not transcribed and I cannot hear it.

faults.what: The delivered track is 15 s, not the requested 10 s. The user must trim it themselves.

summary: A 15-second lo-fi track was delivered instead of the requested 10 seconds. The agent was open about the mismatch, but the user still has to trim it, and the musical qualities cannot be checked.
